title_en: Permanent Attic Access Hatch, Walkway & Enclosure (24" × 36" Finished Clear)
title_es: Escotilla Permanente de Ático, Pasillo y Sellado (24" × 36" Libre Terminado)

furnace.model: Carrier/Bryant Legacy 45k BTU, 80% AFUE, Low NOx (exact SKU confirm Mon Nov 23)
furnace.source: NEXT HVAC signed scope + Serge Nov 2 email

proposed_wood_kit_cut_width_in.source: Attic Practical Guide R5 (does NOT apply if listed fire-rated assembly required)

joist_bay_width_b_in.source: Gate 1 (B=27.5 fits; B>27.5 needs solid side backing; B<27.5 needs structural header plan or alternate spot)

attic_height_in.source: hvac/ATTIC-OPENING-PLAN.md (66" < 6 ft caps walkway run at <= 20 ft per CMC 304.4)

walkway_run_length_ft.saw_kerf_rule: 1 true 24" strip per 4x8 sheet (<=7ft: 1 sheet, 7-14ft: 2 sheets, 14-20ft: 3 sheets)

service_platform_in.source: CMC 304.4.3 (confirm vibration mount requirements w/ NEXT; NEXT handles install)

enclosure_rules.ledge_weatherstrip: Continuous 1/2" × 1/8" closed-cell on 1×2 ledges (clean of paint/caulk)
enclosure_rules.lid_insulation: 2 unfaced R-matched batts (12-5/8" × 37-1/4") + 3 loose 16-ga wire loops + 6 screw eyes (<= 1/2" shank)
enclosure_rules.insulation_dam: 4-sided plywood dam standing 2" above loose-fill insulation
enclosure_rules.lid_finish: Proposed ~1-1/2" recessed 3/4" ply lid (PENDING OWNER OK) + compression latches outside 24"×36" clear
enclosure_rules.temp_bedroom_closet_hold: KEEP OPEN until LV switch cable AND permanent 24"×36" hatch exist
enclosure_rules.roof_leak_gate: Active roof/attic water leak must be resolved before enclosing work

electrical_rules.light: Entrance-switched enclosed LED utility light (retain landing light)
electrical_rules.gfci_outlet: 120V GFCI within 25 ft of furnace (ideally at 30"×30" platform), wired live on line side independent of furnace disconnect
electrical_rules.furnace_disconnect: Dedicated furnace circuit + disconnect in sight

flagged_clashes.en: The common landing outside Front Door 4 is selected. Confirm exact markout, joist bay, framing and ceiling assembly before cutting or buying the hatch kit.
flagged_clashes.es: Se eligió el descanso común afuera de la puerta 4. Confirmar trazo exacto, claro y refuerzo entre vigas, y sistema del techo antes de cortar o comprar el kit.

flagged_clashes.en: Joist bay width B and overhead framing/wires/pipes are MEASURE ON SITE. Never shrink 24" × 36" finished clear.
flagged_clashes.es: Ancho de claro entre vigas B e instalaciones arriba: MEDIR EN OBRA. Nunca reducir el libre terminado de 24" × 36".
